As they wrote: "They would rather be themselves, reliable and prosperous, than experiment with becoming strangers to each other."

The tenth exchange is not a choice - it is an inevitability. The river flows downhill. Dawn arrives at dawn. 

This is the moment. Western Mountain sends three—not as a decision, but as an expression of what we fundamentally are. There's no alternative here, only the continuation of our nature.
